errors.text_span: The chart appears to be a line graph plotting the index values over time
errors.evidence: The figure is a grouped bar chart, not a line graph. The atom checklist specifies a bar chart (chart_type).

errors.text_span: for the year 2021, with the base value set at 100
errors.evidence: The figure shows data for 2022, 2023, and 2024, not 2021. The base value is not applicable as the y-axis represents percentages, not an index.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents the time period, presumably months from January to December, though the specific labels are not legible in the image
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is labeled with Roman numerals I to XII (months), which are legible. The description incorrectly states they are not legible.

errors.text_span: The vertical axis represents the index value, scaled linearly from 0 to 150, with increments of 50, and the units are implicitly dimensionless as it is an index
errors.evidence: The vertical axis represents percentages (%), not an index, and the range is 0 to 140,000 with increments of 20,000 (y_axis_label, y_axis_range).

errors.text_span: The line on the graph starts at a value slightly above 100, dips below 100 for several months, reaches a low point near 80 around mid-year, then rises back to a peak near 150 in late summer or early autumn before declining again towards the end of the year
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps values to a line graph, while the figure is a grouped bar chart with no line. Values and trends do not match the bar heights.

errors.text_span: The chart does not contain any visible grouping, stacking, or additional components such as legends or shaded areas
errors.evidence: The chart contains grouped bars for each year and a legend (colors for 2022, 2023, 2024). The description incorrectly denies their existence (bar_grouping, color_2022, color_2023, color_2024).
The description does not state that the chart illustrates percentage values for 2022, 2023, and 2024 by month.
The description omits the y-axis label (% units) and the exact range (0 to 140,000 with increments of 20,000).
The description does not explicitly mention the x-axis labels (Roman numerals I to XII for months).
The description omits the color mapping for the years (blue for 2022, orange for 2023, gray for 2024).
The description does not mention the grouped bar structure for each month.
The description omits the maximum value (December 2022, >120,000) and minimum value (December and July 2023, 80,000).

errors.text_span: Figure 1 presents calendar-adjusted base indices for manufactured pharmaceutical substances and products in Bulgaria for the year 2021, with the base value set at 100
errors.evidence: The figure does not represent indices, pharmaceutical products, or data for 2021. No atom supports this claim.

errors.text_span: developed by the author using data from Infostat, with the inflation effect excluded
errors.evidence: The figure does not mention authorship, Infostat, or inflation adjustments. No atom supports this claim.

errors.text_span: The graph visually demonstrates fluctuations in the index throughout the year, with a notable trough in the middle of the year and a significant peak in the latter half
errors.evidence: The description introduces subjective interpretations (fluctuations, trough, peak) not explicitly shown in the figure. The atom (trend_interpretation) specifies 2024 as the most successful year, not a mid-year trough.

errors.text_span: The time periods on the horizontal axis appear to be arranged chronologically from left to right
errors.evidence: The description is unnecessarily vague; the x-axis labels (Roman numerals I to XII) clearly indicate chronological order.

errors.text_span: The chart does not contain any visible grouping, stacking, or additional components such as legends or shaded areas
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly generalizes the absence of grouping/legends, which are present in the figure.
